name: ultimate-website-skills
description: Ultimate Website Skills (UWS for Claude). Build cinematic, editorial websites the way an award-winning studio does: WebGL mesh gradients, three-plane parallax with real depth, three.js exploded product views, GSAP and anime.js scroll choreography, and a typographic system that does not read as AI-generated. Ships a copy-in CSS chassis, motion and WebGL runtimes, a section library, a scaffolder, a headless render check and a reference-site study tool.
